text:
Nina (Mktg): Quick kit request for the inference economics webinar next Thu. Need: 3 hero images (1200x628, 800x800, 1920x1080), 2 process diagrams (routing + fallback), a one-page SDR crib sheet, and a 15-20s animated fallback slide. First pass Tue morning pls.

Omar (Design): Got it. I'm free Tue morning only. Drop the exact copy + any numbers.

Kai (PMM): Headline: "Predictable inference economics: budgetable latency". Stat: "~2.3x cost reduction vs naive serving with batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)". CTA: "Configuration guide + live demo".

June (Webinar): Diagram style: swimlane for animation. Sparkline with 3 callouts (baseline, batched+cache, dedicated) and short hover text. Need motion spec for fallback: fade+slide, 18s total.

Omar (Design): Callout copy (6 words max) please.

Nina (Mktg): Callouts: Baseline: "single-request, no batching — higher unit cost"; Batched+cache: "batching + KV cache — lower cost"; Dedicated: "reserved capacity — predictable latency & throughput".

Riley (Legal): Add this footnote exactly: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results vary by model and traffic patterns." Then legal can sign off.

Omar (Design): Plan: PNG mockups Tue 9:30, animated prototype Tue 4pm. I'll push to Figma and tag @Nina @June @Kai.

AssetBot: Comment on /assets/diagrams/seq-1: "please provide routing lane labels"

Nina (Mktg): Routing labels: "ingest → policy-router → model-pool → fallback". Owners: Omar (design), Kai (copy), Riley (legal), June (timing). Thanks all! :rocket:
